definitions.explanation: The interior space of a shop or store.

examples.japanese: {店内|てんない}での{飲食|いんしょく}は{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Eating and drinking inside the store is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {店内|てんない}でお{召|め}し{上|あ}がりになりますか。
examples.english: Will you be eating inside the store?

examples.japanese: {店内|てんない}は{禁煙|きんえん}です。
examples.english: Smoking is prohibited inside the store.

notes:
COMPOUND: {店|てん} (store) + {内|ない} (inside)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {店内|てんない}で (inside the store)
- {店内|てんない}での〜 (~ inside the store)
- {店内|てんない}でお{召|め}し{上|あ}がりですか (Will you eat here? - polite)

SIMILAR LOCATION COMPOUNDS:
- {室内|しつない} (indoors, inside a room)
- {車内|しゃない} (inside a vehicle)
- {社内|しゃない} (inside a company)
- {校内|こうない} (inside a school)

When ordering at cafes or restaurants, you may be asked 「{店内|てんない}ですか、お{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}りですか」 (For here or to go?).
